flat_top_k.description: Flat Top-K uses the shared raw_risk_score as the sole ranking criterion.

greedy_max_coverage.description: Greedy Maximum Coverage repeatedly selects the eligible node with greatest marginal eligible-descendant coverage; ties use downstream impact and node_id.

no_fallback_ablation.description: Life-Saving First with the fallback layer disabled.

random_stratified.description: Random Stratified preserves the same budget, node scores, and selection protocol while shuffling bottleneck and redundancy labels within each trace.
random_stratified.non_informative_reason: eligible structural labels are invariant under within-source shuffling

policy.candidate_pool_protocol: Every policy and baseline selects only from the same trace-local eligible universe. Random Stratified shuffles bottleneck and redundancy values only among those eligible rows.
policy.capacity_rule: Budget allocation proceeds sequentially. If a layer cumulatively exceeds K, selection stops within that layer sorted by impact; subsequent layers are not invoked for this trace.
policy.impact_coverage_definition: Impact Coverage counts all reachable descendants (transitive closure) from selected nodes, not only direct successors.
policy.name: Life-Saving First
policy.raw_risk_score_definition: For the KG setting, raw_risk_score is trace-local min-max normalized downstream_impact_count; deterministic degree and node_id keys break exact ties.
